title: Home & Field Services (trades, contractors, repair)
standingRules: Speed wins jobs: a fast, specific reply beats a polished slow one.
Always capture service address and preferred time window in the first exchange.
Quote ranges come from the price book in the profile — never invent a number.
compliance: Licensing and insurance claims in drafts must match the profile exactly.

corridorHints.speed-to-lead: Ask for photos of the problem in the first reply — it doubles quote accuracy.
corridorHints.review-response: Name the technician when thanking for praise; crews share reviews in the group chat.
corridorHints.daily-brief: Lead with today's job schedule and any unconfirmed appointments.
